jobs.title: Director of Customer Success
jobs.description:
This employer is hiring for a Director, Customer Success to lead the account management function, driving customer retention, renewals, and expansion outcomes across an enterprise portfolio.

The Role

• Lead and develop the account management team, fostering strong customer relationships and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
• Own retention, renewal, and expansion outcomes while maintaining visibility into customer health and proactive risk management.
• Partner with leadership to evolve team structures, customer coverage models, and operational processes as the business grows.
• Drive cross-functional collaboration with sales, product, and other teams to represent customer needs and align business priorities.

What You'll Need

• Significant leadership experience in enterprise SaaS customer success or account management, including experience managing managers.
• Proven success driving customer retention, renewals, and expansion revenue within a high-touch enterprise customer model.
• Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance customer relationships, business priorities, and revenue outcomes.
• Experience operating in a scaling SaaS organization, including collaborating across global time zones.

What's On Offer

• Annual salary of CA$184,714 - CA$225,762 per year.
• Fully remote-first culture with flexible time-off policies and stock options.
• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits alongside learning and professional development support.

Apply via Haystack today!

jobs.title: Director, Grocery Store Development Project Management – Commercial (Food Retail / Plants / Restaurants Modification / Retrofits)– (Cantonese / Mandarin – preferred)
jobs.description:
Director, Grocery Store Development – Commercial (Food Retail / Plants / Restaurants Modification / Retrofits)– (Cantonese / Mandarin – preferred)

Location: Toronto, ON area

Salary 155K -195K base, Bonus, Benefits

Full-time permanent job; 5 days on site

Approx. 20% travel

Our client is a well-established importer / retailer / distributor of Oriental Foods (temperature controlled – Fresh Frozen & Ambient).
As part of their growth and expansion plans to open new retail stores/ restaurants / grocery outlets,
they have an existing job open for Director, Grocery Store Development
to lead multiple projects preconstruction, fit outs & construction of new upcoming store / retail units. This role is fully responsible for leading a team during pre-construction assessments in existing building, creating technical specifications of equipment, estimation, liaison and negotiation with landlords and assist in selection with subcontractors (architects, electrical mechanical multi -trade GCs) to develop budgets, provide feasibility reports to senior leadership, manage all approvals, lease permits and hand over the project scope to the construction teams. This is 5 days on site, less than 20% travel across Canada. The job is based in Toronto, ON . Cantonese / Mandarin is an asset.

Director, Grocery Store Development
will lead
the technical due diligence and the feasibility assessments of existing buildings to convert to future prospective retail stores / restaurants / grocery stores including HVAC, refrigeration, electrical, plumbing, and similar, oversee technical requirements, identify infrastructure upgrades required to convert existing commercial properties, develop preliminary CAPEX estimates, project budgets, engineering scopes and business cases for investment approvals. You will oversee architects / interior designers / GC to review proposed store layouts, equipment, specifications and building constraints fit ups with property landlords, ensure city / municipalities permits and approvals are in place and prepare the technical tender packages. This is a leadership role

Qualified candidates able to speak Cantonese / Mandarin and excellent English willing to work 5 days on site / in office in Toronto, ON
are welcome to send their resumes as WORD doc to Preeti.Dayal@hays.com.
Please write “Director, Grocery Store Development – Food Retail” in the subject line of the e mail.

While we thank all applicants for your interest, only the most qualified candidates will be contacted due to volume of applicants.

AI may be used to screen, assess, or select applicants for this position.
